projects.name: Private Residence 01
projects.title: Private Residence 01
projects.tagline: A home in harmony with its surroundings.
projects.subtitle_en: A home in harmony with its surroundings.
projects.subtitle_ar: منزل متناغم مع محيطه الطبيعي ويوفر ملاذاً هادئاً.
projects.heading: A refined balance of architecture and nature.
projects.headingAr: توازن دقيق بين روعة العمارة وجمال الطبيعة.
projects.description: This private residence was designed as a serene retreat where modern architecture meets a warm, timeless atmosphere. The design embraces open spaces, natural materials and a strong connection to the outdoors, creating a home that feels both elegant and personal. Travertine volumes are layered with vertical wood screens and expansive glazing, allowing the garden and pool to become part of daily life inside the house.
projects.descriptionAr: صُممت هذه الإقامة الخاصة كملاذ هادئ حيث تلتقي العمارة الحديثة بالأجواء الدافئة الخالدة. يتبنى التصميم الفراغات المفتوحة والمواد الطبيعية والاتصال القوي بالطبيعة الخارجية، مع كتل الترافيرتين وشاشات الخشب الرأسية والواجهات الزجاجية الممتدة.
projects.details_en: This private residence was designed as a serene retreat where modern architecture meets a warm, timeless atmosphere.
projects.details_ar: صُممت هذه الإقامة الخاصة كملاذ هادئ يجمع بين العمارة الحديثة والدفء الكلاسيكي.
projects.philosophy: A dialogue between modern living and natural serenity, where every space is intentionally crafted to enhance the way people live.
projects.vision_en: A dialogue between modern living and natural serenity, where every space is intentionally crafted to enhance the way people live.
projects.vision_ar: حوار هندسي بين متطلبات المعيشة العصرية والسكينة الطبيعية، حيث تم تصميم كل فراغ بعناية لتعزيز جودة الحياة اليومية.

projects.name: Lake House
projects.title: Lake House
projects.tagline: Rooted in the landscape. Designed for a slower, richer life.
projects.subtitle_en: Rooted in the landscape. Designed for a slower, richer life.
projects.subtitle_ar: متجذر في تضاريس الموقع، ومصمم لحياة أكثر عمقاً وهدوءاً.
projects.heading: A quiet structure resting on water.
projects.headingAr: كتلة معمارية هادئة تستقر فوق سطح الماء.
projects.description: The Lake House is a low, horizontal composition that extends over calm water on a timber deck. A cantilevered roof shelters the living spaces while travertine walls anchor the house to its site. Reeds, olive trees and native planting soften the edge between architecture and landscape, so the building appears to have always belonged there.
projects.descriptionAr: تكوين أفقي منخفض يمتد فوق سطح الماء الهادئ عبر منصات خشبية متدرجة وسقف كابولي يحمي المساحات المعيشية وجدران الترافيرتين الراسية.
projects.details_en: The Lake House is a low, horizontal composition that extends over calm water on a timber deck.
projects.details_ar: تكوين أفقي منخفض يمتد فوق سطح الماء عبر منصات خشبية متدرجة.
projects.philosophy: Architecture lives longer when it belongs.
projects.vision_en: Architecture lives longer when it belongs.
projects.vision_ar: تدوم العمارة طويلاً حين تنتمي بتناغم تام إلى بيئتها وطبيعتها.

projects.name: The Urban Retreat
projects.title: The Urban Retreat
projects.tagline: A refined urban sanctuary that balances warmth, materiality and modern living.
projects.subtitle_en: A refined urban sanctuary that balances warmth, materiality and modern living.
projects.subtitle_ar: ملاذ حضري فاخر يوازن بين الدفء والمواد النبيلة والحياة العصرية.
projects.heading: Calm, material and deeply personal.
projects.headingAr: هدوء وأناقة ومواد تعبر عن الخصوصية العميقة.
projects.description: A complete interior transformation of a city apartment into a warm, layered retreat. Dark walnut panelling, travertine surfaces and a linear fireplace create a sense of stillness, while carefully controlled lighting shapes the mood from morning to night. Every piece of furniture and every finish was selected to feel timeless rather than fashionable.
projects.descriptionAr: تحول داخلي شامل لشقة في قلب المدينة إلى ملاذ دافئ من خشب الجوز والترافيرتين الطبيعي والمدفأة الخطية مع إضاءة مدروسة بعناية.
projects.details_en: A complete interior transformation of a city apartment into a warm, layered retreat.
projects.details_ar: تحول داخلي شامل لشقة في قلب المدينة إلى ملاذ دافئ وهادئ.
projects.philosophy: Spaces shaped by purpose, character and detail.
projects.vision_en: Spaces shaped by purpose, character and detail.
projects.vision_ar: فراغات معمارية تشكلها الغاية والخصوصية والدقة في أدق التفاصيل.

projects.name: Hillside Villa
projects.title: Hillside Villa
projects.subtitle_ar: منحوتة في تضاريس الموقع ومطلة على زرقة البحر.
projects.heading: Built into the slope, open to the sea.
projects.headingAr: منحوتة في تضاريس الجبل، ومفتوحة على زرقة البحر.
projects.description: Set into a steep coastal site, the villa steps down the hillside in a series of stone terraces. Wide external stairs move through native planting toward the sea, and each level opens onto its own shaded outdoor room. Structural and MEP coordination through BIM allowed the complex terracing to be resolved precisely before construction began.
projects.descriptionAr: فيلا مدرجة على منحدر ساحلي عبر مصاطب حجرية وأدراج واسعة وسط نباتات المنطقة نحو البحر، منسقة بدقة عبر نمذجة الـ BIM الهندسية.
projects.details_en: Set into a steep coastal site, the villa steps down the hillside in a series of stone terraces.
projects.details_ar: فيلا ساحلية متدرجة عبر مصاطب حجرية وأدراج واسعة.

projects.name: Urban Commercial Hub
projects.title: Urban Commercial Hub
projects.tagline: A civic presence in limestone and bronze.
projects.subtitle_en: A civic presence in limestone and bronze.
projects.subtitle_ar: حضور عمراني رائد بالحجر الجيري والبرونز في قلب الرياض.
projects.heading: Precision at an urban scale.
projects.description: A mixed-use commercial building on a prominent Riyadh plaza. Deep recessed windows and bronze vertical fins control the harsh desert light while giving the limestone façade rhythm and depth. Full technical documentation and MEP coordination were delivered alongside the design, ensuring a seamless transition from concept to construction.
projects.descriptionAr: مبنى تجاري متعدد الاستخدامات في ساحة بارزة بالرياض، يتميز بنوافذ عميقة وكواسر شمسية برونزية وتكسيات حجرية متطورة مع تنسيق MEP كامل.

projects.heading: Tradition, reinterpreted.
projects.description: A private majlis that honours the ritual of gathering. Backlit geometric screens in carved wood wrap the room, low seating follows the perimeter, and a single brass pendant marks the centre. Contemporary in its restraint, traditional in its generosity.
projects.descriptionAr: مجلس خاص يحتفي بتقاليد الضيافة الأصيلة، بقواطع خشبية هندسية مضيئة وجلسات محيطية وثريا نحاسية أيقونية.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.role: You will lead design development on residential and commercial projects, from concept through technical documentation, working closely with our interior, landscape and engineering teams.
responsibilities: Develop architectural concepts into coordinated design packages
Produce plans, sections, elevations and detail drawings
Coordinate with structural and MEP consultants through BIM
Present design work to clients and stakeholders
requirements: 3–5 years of experience in a design-led practice
Strong portfolio demonstrating design sensibility and technical depth
Fluent English; Arabic is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Interior Designer
jobs.role: You will own interior concepts on high-end residential and hospitality projects — space planning, materials, FF&E and lighting — and guide junior designers through execution.
responsibilities: Lead interior concept and design development
Curate material palettes, finishes and FF&E
Produce technical interior drawings and details
Coordinate with suppliers, contractors and the architecture team
requirements: Degree in Interior Design or Architecture
5+ years of experience on luxury interiors

jobs.title: BIM Coordinator
jobs.role: You will manage federated BIM models across architecture, structure and MEP, run clash detection and keep our technical documentation precise and coordinated.
responsibilities: Set up and maintain BIM execution plans
Coordinate multidisciplinary models and resolve clashes
Support project teams with modelling and QA
requirements: 3+ years in a BIM coordination role

jobs.title: Landscape Architect
jobs.role: You will design outdoor environments — from masterplan to planting detail — that extend the architecture and respond to climate, context and people.
responsibilities: Select planting suited to regional climates
Coordinate with architecture and engineering teams
requirements: Knowledge of regional planting and irrigation
